hero.name: 馮煥曉

sw.title: Software

sol.meta: Aug 2026 — Present · ~2,000 commits · In production company-wide
sol.desc: Doctor content production system for SOL Integrative Wellness Centre: one sentence writes a full month of scripts → doctors film on a phone teleprompter → automatic rough cut → review → scheduled social publishing → one-click KPI reports. Used daily by non-technical staff across the company, with a Chinese / English / Malay interface.
sol.open: Open the SOL Studio landing page
features: Create Script: type “Dr Vig November” and AI writes the whole month in the doctor’s own voice, with hooks and medical-claims checks; also parses Marketing’s monthly PPT plans
Mobile filming app (iOS / Android, Expo): shot cards + scrolling teleprompter, with automatic upload and filing to the shared drive
AI auto rough cut: removes pauses and retakes, Whisper-aligned captions, B-roll matching, animated key figures, 3-second hooks, covers
Pass to AI: edit a video with one sentence; jobs queue to AI helpers on each Mac; exports CapCut project files
Browser timeline editor: multitrack, color grading, voice separation, background removal, transitions, 16 caption styles, and AI-cut to watch AI edit step by step
Multicam podcasts: cameras and mics auto-synced by audio, with automatic switching to whoever is speaking
Design board: AI writes FB / IG post copy; Auto Design produces three layered, editable PSD versions at once
Doctor AI voiceover: in-house cloned voices for narration; phone numbers read digit by digit, mixed English/Malay read as written
GHL scheduled publishing: FB / IG / TikTok / YouTube, with comment monitoring that alerts on new replies
Library of 3,000+ finished videos, dashboard, Content KPI Excel reports, webinars and client lists
Permissions and privacy: role/department access, chat tied to member identity, patient consent forms visible only to authorised staff
MCP server: Claude and other external AIs can create tasks, write scripts and read timelines directly in the app
sol.caption: The public SOL Studio landing page (the working system sits behind login). It grew out of AI-Content-studio (Aug 2026, MVP: web scripting → phone teleprompter filming → automatic post-production).

onset.meta: Started Nov 2026 · Full rewrite from scratch · In development
onset.desc: A personal studio app for everyday creators: scripting, filming, editing, covers and posts all in one place. Ask Onset, in the bottom-right of every screen, brings in AI help — and you can watch it work step by step and stop it anytime. Targets macOS, Windows, iOS and Android.
features: AI Onset first-run setup: a short Q&A sets your channel style, auto-organised into script / interview / design / editing styles (36 built in)
AI Script: five formats — short video, long-form, interview questions, podcast rundown, voiceover — sent straight to filming
Recording: webcam or external camera + teleprompter with adjustable speed and font
CapCut-style editor: keyframes, 39 transitions, masks, LUTs (incl. HLG / Apple Log / S-Log3 → 709), speed curves, stabilisation
Captions: Whisper speech-to-text, 20 caption styles, 13 fonts, karaoke word-by-word highlighting
Auto-cut and AI Edit: auto-removes pauses and retakes; AI edits chapter by chapter, every step shown live on the timeline
Audio: noise reduction, Demucs voice/background separation, AI voiceover, music and SFX, auto-ducking
Multicam podcasts and 2-hour+ long-form: auto-sync, speaker-based switching, chapter-by-chapter processing
Covers and image posts: 35 layouts, 44 design operations, for FB / IG / Xiaohongshu / TikTok / X / Threads
Export: MP4 / MOV / MP3 / WAV, plus CapCut, FCPXML, Premiere XML and FilmCraft project files
Animation mode: make videos without filming, using graphics, text animation and Godot 2D/3D
MCP: external AIs can drive the editor directly while Onset is open
onset.cap_editing: Editing: media bins on the left, preview in the centre, properties and AI Edit on the right, multitrack timeline below.
onset.cap_start: The home screen has just five entry points, with Ask Onset at the bottom right.
onset.cap_setup: First run: AI Onset works out your style one question at a time.
onset.cap_styles: Setup complete — four styles generated automatically.
onset.cap_script: Create Script: chat with AI on the left, script on the right.
onset.cap_design: macOS design mockup drawn before development began.

vpipe.desc: A small web app that runs MiniMax H3 (video with sound) and Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (images) locally on a Mac — no cloud, no credits. Built-in setup checks and one-click model download, AI prompt enhancement, character LoRAs, queueing and 2× upscaling; offloads work to the Neural Engine, cutting a 5-second video on an M3 Air from ~73 to ~35 minutes.

stock.desc: US and Malaysian (Bursa Malaysia) stock research dashboard: market overview, candlestick charts and news per stock, holding signals with plain-language notes, backtesting, a paper-trading account, and daily Traditional Chinese briefings written by four AI assistants. Python + Streamlit, runs locally only.
